generationInputs.prompt: A fair-skinned older woman with light gray shoulder-length wavy hair smiles gently behind a wooden table laden with fresh food in a warm kitchen setting. The woman has an oval face with soft lines, a medium forehead partially covered by her swept-back light gray hair, subtly defined cheekbones, and a rounded jawline. Her medium-sized, almond-shaped dark eyes are framed by well-defined medium-thick eyebrows with a slight upward arch. A straight, medium-sized nose sits above her medium-thick lips, which are slightly upturned in a gentle smile revealing aligned, complete, natural teeth. Visible are her ears, proportionate to her face, adorned with medium-sized circular gold hoop earrings; the right ear is partially obscured by her hair. Her long, dense, smooth, light gray hair is styled back, with some volume falling over her shoulders. She has a short to medium neck, visible with a thin gold necklace featuring a small circular pendant. Her shoulders are straight and slightly back. She wears a dark gray V-neck blouse under a light beige cardigan. Her fair skin tone is even and smooth, illuminated by soft light from the front-left. Her hands rest on the wooden table. The wooden table displays a symmetrical arrangement of food items: a small wooden bowl of green pumpkin seeds, a red bell pepper, a small wooden bowl of tan grains, a wooden cutting board with raw red meat, a clear glass of white liquid, a red apple, a green apple, half an avocado, a small wooden bowl of red strawberries, and a bunch of yellow bananas. Behind her, the kitchen features a backsplash of small brown and beige square tiles, with a muted beige wall above. Two wooden shelves are mounted on the wall: the top shelf holds a terra cotta bowl of yellow bananas, a larger terra cotta bowl, and a small terra cotta pot with a green leafy plant; the lower shelf holds a small terra cotta jar with a lid, a small glass jar, a larger terra cotta bowl, a small potted green plant, and a dark-colored mortar and pestle. A glimpse of another dark object is visible on the countertop to the right. The lighting is soft and warm.
